verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an observability platform like SigNoz, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks. It only gives generic mentions of alerts, 'timely notifications' and 'notification channels', which do not show that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to events over HTTP. Those adjacent alerting and notification features earn no credit under the webhooks rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
